name: Easy Demo
description: Annotate any web page with shapes and a focus spotlight. Record the tab as a demo video with optional mic and tab audio.
author: Moblize.it LLC

action.default_title: Easy Demo — toggle annotator (Alt+A) / recording dashboard during a recording

_execute_action.description: Toggle Easy Demo (same as clicking the toolbar icon)

toggle-annotator.description: Toggle the Easy Demo annotator overlay

start-recording.description: Start a screen recording of the current tab

stop-recording.description: Stop the active recording and save the video

toggle-pause-recording.description: Pause or resume the active recording (configure shortcut in chrome://extensions/shortcuts)
